seif.title: Mila's Safe
seif.intro: Enter the data for your Mila. It goes straight into her private file, bypassing chat and email. No person will see it; Mila uses it only through her own tool at the moment of action.
seif.once: This link works once and lives {min} minutes.
seif.gone.p: It works once and lives 30 minutes. Ask Mila for a new one.
seif.saved.p: You can close this page. Mila already knows the data is in place.
seif.bad.p: Mila's folder is not set up as expected. The link still works — tell Mila.
